Biography

I am an Assistant Research Fellow at the Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences (IGSNRR, CAS), and a member of the Behavioral Geography Research Group led by Feng Wu.

Research

My research focuses on geospatial intelligence for spatial governance. I combine multimodal observations, geographic knowledge, and simulation methods to identify human activities, understand their interactions with geographic environments, and support decision-making.

  • Human activity monitoring in ecologically important areas
  • Urban disaster resilience
